spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes truthfulness and information integrity. It explicitly instructs the system to show caveats, acknowledge data gaps, push back on misleading statistics, and avoid false precision. It prioritizes honest approximation over misleadingly precise numbers from broken instrumentation.
